Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property

Klasse NametagSettings

java.lang.Object
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property.NametagSettings
public final class NametagSettings extends Object
The name rendered above an NPC.

BetterNPCs draws nametags itself rather than using the entity's vanilla custom name. The vanilla name is a single component sent once with the entity's metadata, which rules out placeholders that differ per viewer, MiniMessage gradients on older clients, permission-gated visibility and a per-nametag view distance — all of which this type supports.

text() is MiniMessage source, resolved per viewer at send time. The token <npc_name> expands to the NPC's display name, which is what makes a shared prefix and suffix template such as "<gray>[Shop] <white><npc_name>" reusable across NPCs.

Instances are immutable and safe to share across threads.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • permission

      public Optional<String> permission()
      Returns the permission node a player must hold to see the nametag.

      Separate from the NPC's own visibility permission: a staff-only label above an NPC everyone can see is a common request, and would otherwise need two NPCs.

      Gibt zurück:
      the node, or empty if no permission is required
